entities.name: Slimefoot
entities.description: A thallid grown from a spore on the Weatherlight's hull, an unofficial crew member, ship mascot and deck swab.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: Reconstructed skyship whose hull holds part of the Llanowar forest's soul.

entities.name: Jhoira
entities.description: Captain of the Weatherlight who restored the ship.

entities.name: Molimo
entities.description: Avatar of the Llanowar forest who gave Jhoira a Weatherseed.

entities.name: Llanowar
entities.description: Forest whose avatar Molimo gave the Weatherseed.

entities.name: Saprolings
entities.description: Herd tended by Slimefoot to help keep the ship clean.

entities.name: Belzenlok
entities.description: Demon whose Stronghold the Weatherlight attacked.

entities.name: Muldrotha
entities.description: Urborg's elemental avatar whose help Slimefoot procured.

entities.name: Yargle
entities.description: Attacked the skyship while Slimefoot steered it.

entities.name: Squee
entities.description: Fought beside Slimefoot in Dominaria's defense.

entities.name: New Phyrexian invasion
entities.description: Invasion of Dominaria during which Slimefoot served aboard the Weatherlight.

events.summary: In Jhoira's restoration of the Weatherlight, a spark of life in the wood grows into Slimefoot.
events.quote: some spark of life took root in the wood and eventually grew into Slimefoot

events.summary: In the attack on Belzenlok's Stronghold, Slimefoot procures Muldrotha's help and steers the skyship during Yargle's attack.
events.quote: Slimefoot played a pivotal role by procuring the help of Muldrotha

events.summary: Slimefoot helps protect the Weatherlight's powerstone as the ship is overtaken by Phyrexian corruption.
events.quote: It later helped to protect the Weatherlight's powerstone as the ship was overtaken by Phyrexian corruption.

events.summary: Slimefoot fights alongside Squee in defense of Dominaria.
events.quote: Slimefoot fought alongside Squee in defense of Dominaria during the New Phyrexian Invasion .
